text:
tia: Quick sync — two customers asked for a short trial of the Optimize Toolkit (batching, caching, quant recs, eval alerts). Need to lock minimal alpha scope and pass/fail checks by Friday so sales can onboard.

sam: Engineering proposal: recommendations-only APIs (no auto-apply) for batching, prefix-cache, and quant reports; a measurement endpoint to estimate prefix hit rate; and an eval-alert adapter that posts webhooks/Slack when a metric regresses beyond a threshold.

leo: I'll deliver a compact model-compatibility table marking safe quant modes and a 3-model bench. Will tag models we must exclude.

anya: CS asks that every rec include: 1) one-line rationale, 2) confidence (low/med/high), 3) a simple JSON reason field. Customers require a manual accept toggle in the UI.

rachel: Sales/SRE: pilots must include canary routing + automatic fallback to hosted inference if p95 latency or error rate exceeds SLO. Also need a short runbook for rollback and contacts.

sam: Example smoke check we will run for customers: curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/optimize/suggest -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d '{"route":"payments-chat","seq_len":128,"model":"redwood-7b"}' -> expect batching, cache, quant_report, explanation, confidence, measurement_endpoint.

tia: Proposed numeric gates: primary quality metric drop <=1.5% during pilot; token cost reduction >=10% OR p50 latency improvement >=10% to count as value; eval-alert default threshold = 5%.

leo: For quant_report include which eval metric and sample size, and flag when results are noisy.

anya: CS pilot checklist: onboarding doc, 2-week dashboard (baseline vs pilot), weekly checkpoints, rollback tested, SRE signoff.

sam: Rough ETA if parallel: rec APIs + measurement endpoint = 3w, quant bench + comp table = 2w, eval-alert adapter = 1.5w, dashboard stub + toggle = 1.5w -> target 4-5w alpha.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: reserved a pilot deploy window 2024-06-30 02:00 UTC.

tia: Decision call: lock minimal alpha to recommendations-only APIs, measurement endpoint, basic eval-alerts (webhook/Slack/email), pilot dashboard stub, runbook + rollback. If no objections by EOD Fri we'll commit. React with :thumbsup: or list blockers.
